ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes and 55% low-intensity black pixels concentrated centrally.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on the lateral distal portions of both lobes; solid black central band spanning the median notch area; high-frequency stochastic mottling (speckling) at the interface of black and white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped depression; approximate aperture angle of 145 degrees; notch depth is roughly 10% of the total vertical pixel span of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency low-amplitude serrations; a prominent deep pixel-valley (indentation) is located on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the outer margins, tapering into acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete low-intensity circular clusters (approximately 5-10 pixels in diameter) distributed within the white distal fields of both lobes, representing localized pigment loss or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible as faint dark streaks on the high-intensity region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and a distinct indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, adjacent to the median notch, indicating physical trauma.
